Questions About the Archive

Why are Volumes 15–20 treated as one Illuminati sequence?

The original pages clearly form a sequence: Vol. 15 covers origins and Adam Weishaupt; Vol. 16 moves into wealth, the thirteen families and New World Order narratives; Vol. 17 covers ritual and occult claims; Vol. 18 covers celebrity and music symbolism; Vol. 19 turns to end-times themes; Vol. 20 asks whether the Illuminati is real and focuses on evidence.

Are conspiracy claims presented as proven facts?

No. This companion preserves the story subjects while distinguishing documented historical organizations from later folklore, allegations, symbolic interpretations and internet conspiracy narratives.

Why do some sections use inline SVG?

The SVG layer is the visual backup. It is part of the HTML itself, so a reader still receives an illustration when a remote public image is unavailable. Public images are lazy-loaded to keep the initial page responsive.

The Handoff to the England Chronicle

Vol. 40 ends the retrospective at Vol. 27. From here the historical sequence continues with Vol. 28 and the long study of Britain before England, followed by the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms, Viking England, the Norman Conquest and the later Plantagenet story.
